prompt: I run a high-ticket fitness transformation coaching program called FORGE. 12-week program, $2,997. Target: men 30-45 who want to look and feel elite.
assertions: Output is a single valid HTML file
Has checkerboard grid with spatial typography
Accent color suggests fitness/energy (not default pink)
Has a Card Grid section showing program tiers or features
Copy voice is intense and commanding
Hero phrase is short (3-5 words) scattered across tiles
Has GSAP scroll animations on multiple sections
Contact section includes email form with {{FORM_ENDPOINT}}
Includes price or program details somewhere on the page
All spatial typography words are 6 characters or fewer
Global snap uses custom snapTo function (not simple array snap)
No scroll snap-back loop between sections
Contact footer in normal flow with mt-auto
Card buttons consistently at bottom via margin-top auto
Non-pinned sections use toggleActions for reverse on scroll-back
